tagline: Dodol Betawi Haji Imang from Pondok Cabe, Pamulang—traditional Betawi confectionery with registered brand presence.

story.title: Dodol Betawi Haji Imang from Pondok Cabe, Pamulang—traditional Betawi confectionery with registered brand presence.
story.body: Government and marketplace records identify Dodol Betawi Haji Imang under Sri Liana in Pondok Cabe/Pamulang. The brand appears in an Indonesian trademark gazette, in a Banten MSME listing and on Plaza Banten with packaged dodol products such as Dodol Mini Tenong and Mini Gentong.

stats.label: Mini Tenong and Mini Gentong visible on Plaza Banten

highlights.title: Betawi dodol
highlights.body: Traditional confectionery is the documented core product.

highlights.title: Gift packaging
highlights.body: Public marketplace listings show tenong/gentong-style gift formats.

highlights.title: Registered identity
highlights.body: The brand appears in the government trademark gazette.

highlights.title: Local recognition
highlights.body: Sri Liana and the brand are also present in a Banten MSME listing.

verification.note: Claims on this profile were rechecked against public sources on 2026-10-13; unsupported claims and guessed links are intentionally omitted.
